phases.title: Subagent、Team 和 MCP

phases.title: 兼容层关闭、旧代码清退和生产验收
phases.review_evidence: Local code review found no blocking critical/high findings; the CozeLoop adapter avoids the known v0.1.23 ForceFlush race path and its targeted tests pass. A 2026-09-04 WSL race run passed, and the verifier now supports reusable external race evidence for hosts that cannot start WSL directly. Live connectivity gates are complete; remaining production drills stay external_required until real fault-injection, CozeLoop trace, mutation approval, and flywheel publish evidence is collected.
